changelog:
**Summary:** This is a major update focusing on HarmonyOS 7 (API 26) and a streamlined code-expert experience.

- Removed outdated documentation, sample references, skill card, and local build/install scripts.
- Updated to focus exclusively on HarmonyOS 7 (API 26 Beta1), refining guidance and best practices for DevEco Studio 26.0.0 Beta1.
- Skill scope redefined: prioritized ArkTS/ArkUI coding, API migration, auto-detection of deprecated APIs, and strict output/code self-checks.
- Expanded knowledge base structure: 13-section Table of Contents, advanced architecture, performance, and multi-device adaptation guidance included directly.
- All code output now includes version tags, self-check pass badges, and knowledge push-around best practices on complex queries or user confirmation.
- Triggers and description revised for clearer, simpler skill invocation and adaptation to latest HarmonyOS development workflows.
